title: ModelCard
description: Output of `rulekit describe` — the model's fields (with kind, and scale/enum-domain where applicable) and groups (with repeatability). An agent's map of a model without reading raw DM-JSON.

kind.description: value-kind: STRING | NUMBER | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM | DATE | ENUMERATION | CUSTOM | …

scale.description: decimal scale; present for NUMBER fields only

enumValues.description: allowed stored values; present for ENUMERATION fields only

repeatable.description: whether the group repeats (rules over it iterate)
